name: Progress M-64
about: Progress M-64 (2008-023A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M), launched 2008 May 14. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2008 May 22), held fixed
docked to S25544; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
